description: Elections Commission - Notify the Names of members for the Local Authority of Pujapitiya Pradeshiya Sabha, Kandy District
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns electoral matters for the Poojapitiya Pradeshiya Sabha (a local authority). It cancels a previous notice to change the publication date and formally declares the names of elected and returned members for that electoral area. The notice is issued by the Elections Commission under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
